description: Ministry of Labour & Trade Union Relation - Industrial Disputes between United Tea Rubber & Local Produce Workers's Union and Finaly's Colombo Ltd., Colombo 02
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - specifically an order made under Section 4(1) of the Industrial Disputes Act, Chapter 131. It establishes an arbitration process for an industrial dispute between a workers' union and two companies, which falls under legal framework and regulatory matters rather than government structure/personnel changes or other specialized categories.
